evidence.observation: pressure_gauge not_installed; P is null throughout, although the growth stage requires it to verify the atmosphere
Temperature followed the ramp setpoint closely; brief 760.2 °C overshoot at growth start, then settled at about 750 °C
Heater power steady at about 44% during growth, a plausible level
Purge brought O2 down from about 28,800 ppm; it has stayed around 4–7 ppm since, so there is no sign of a leak
Argon flow steady at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading from a gauge that is installed or temporarily fitted, or a manual pressure check. Without it an exhaust blockage or pressure deviation can't be ruled out. Characterization of the sample is also still to come.
